question_en: Which statements are true? 1) The field strength $E=\frac{F}{q}$ does not depend on the test charge. 2) Field lines can cross. 3) In electrostatic equilibrium $E=0$ inside a conductor. 4) A dielectric strengthens the external field.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Kuchlanganlik $E=\frac{F}{q}$ sinov zaryadiga bog'liq emas. 2) Kuch chiziqlari kesishishi mumkin. 3) Elektrostatik muvozanatda o'tkazgich ichida $E=0$. 4) Dielektrik tashqi maydonni kuchaytiradi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Напряжённость $E=\frac{F}{q}$ не зависит от пробного заряда. 2) Силовые линии могут пересекаться. 3) В электростатическом равновесии внутри проводника $E=0$. 4) Диэлектрик усиливает внешнее поле.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1 va 3 to'g'ri; kuch chiziqlari kesishmaydi, dielektrik maydonni ε marta susaytiradi.
Asos: maydon va o'tkazgich xossalari.

ru: 2 — неверно: в каждой точке $\vec E$ единственен.
en: 1, 3 are true: $F\sim q$, inside a conductor $E=0$.
2 is false: $\vec E$ is unique at each point.

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 2 неверно: силовые линии не пересекаются

distractors_en.A: statement 2 is false: field lines do not cross
distractors_en.C: statement 4 is false: a dielectric weakens the field

question_en: A force of $2\ \mathrm{mN}$ acts on a $4\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ charge at some point of a field. Find the field strength at that point ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_uz: Maydonning biror nuqtasidagi $4\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ zaryadga $2\ \mathrm{mN}$ kuch ta'sir qiladi. Shu nuqtadagi kuchlanganlikni toping ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_ru: На заряд $4\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ в некоторой точке поля действует сила $2\ \mathrm{mN}$. Найдите напряжённость в этой точке ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. E = F/q = 2·10⁻³/(4·10⁻⁶) = 500 V/m.
Asos: kuchlanganlik ta'rifi.

distractors_ru.D: mN и μC не переведены в единицы СИ

distractors_en.B: the force was multiplied by the charge
distractors_en.D: mN and μC were not converted to SI
distractors_en.E: nC was used instead of μC

question_en: By what factor does the field of a point charge change if the distance to it is increased $3$ times ($\frac{E_2}{E_1}$)?
question_uz: Nuqtaviy zaryadgacha masofa $3$ marta oshirilsa, maydon kuchlanganligi necha marta o'zgaradi ($\frac{E_2}{E_1}$)?
question_ru: Во сколько раз изменится напряжённость поля точечного заряда, если расстояние до него увеличить в $3$ раза ($\frac{E_2}{E_1}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. E ∼ 1/r²: masofa 3 marta ortsa, E 9 marta kamayadi.
Asos: nuqtaviy zaryad maydoni.

distractors.D: E masofaga to'g'ri proporsional deb olingan

distractors_en.D: E was taken as directly proportional to the distance
distractors_en.E: E does depend on the distance

question_en: What field strength does a $2\ \mathrm{nC}$ point charge produce in vacuum $3\ \mathrm{cm}$ away ($\mathrm{kV/m}$)?
question_uz: $2\ \mathrm{nC}$ nuqtaviy zaryad vakuumda o'zidan $3\ \mathrm{cm}$ masofada qanday kuchlanganlik hosil qiladi ($\mathrm{kV/m}$)?
question_ru: Какую напряжённость создаёт точечный заряд $2\ \mathrm{nC}$ в вакууме на расстоянии $3\ \mathrm{cm}$ от себя ($\mathrm{kV/m}$)?

distractors.E: V/m dan kV/m ga o'tkazishda xato

distractors_ru.E: ошибка при переводе V/m в kV/m

distractors_en.B: the distance was taken as 0.3 cm
distractors_en.C: the distance was taken as 0.3 m
distractors_en.E: an error converting V/m to kV/m

question_en: A uniform field of $5\ \mathrm{kV/m}$ points along the $x$ axis. Find the component $F_x$ of the force on a $-2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ charge in the field ($\mathrm{N}$).
question_uz: Kuchlanganligi $5\ \mathrm{kV/m}$ bo'lgan bir jinsli maydon $x$ o'qi bo'ylab yo'nalgan. Maydondagi $-2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ zaryadga ta'sir qiluvchi kuchning proyeksiyasi $F_x$ ni toping ($\mathrm{N}$).
question_ru: Однородное поле напряжённостью $5\ \mathrm{kV/m}$ направлено вдоль оси $x$. Найдите проекцию $F_x$ силы, действующей на заряд $-2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ в этом поле ($\mathrm{N}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. F = qE = −2·10⁻⁶ · 5000 = −0.01 N — manfiy zaryadga kuch maydonga qarshi.
Asos: F = qE.

uz: Manfiy zaryad — kuch $\vec E$ ga qarshi: $$F_x=qE=-2\cdot10^{-6}\cdot5\cdot10^3=-0.01\ \mathrm{N}$$
en: Negative charge — the force is against $\vec E$: $$F_x=qE=-2\cdot10^{-6}\cdot5\cdot10^3=-0.01\ \mathrm{N}$$

rules.en: Force in a field: $\vec F=q\vec E$

distractors.B: kV/m V/m ga o'tkazilmay va ishorasiz

distractors_ru.B: kV/m не переведено в V/m, знак не учтён

distractors_en.B: kV/m was not converted and the sign was ignored
distractors_en.D: the charge was divided by the field

question_en: Find the field strength at the midpoint between two $+5\ \mathrm{nC}$ charges $20\ \mathrm{cm}$ apart ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_uz: Bir-biridan $20\ \mathrm{cm}$ masofadagi ikkita $+5\ \mathrm{nC}$ zaryadning o'rtasidagi nuqtada maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_ru: Найдите напряжённость поля в точке посередине между двумя зарядами $+5\ \mathrm{nC}$, находящимися на расстоянии $20\ \mathrm{cm}$ друг от друга ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Ikki teng musbat zaryad maydonlari o'rtada teng va qarama-qarshi — yig'indi nol.
Asos: superpozitsiya.

distractors.E: ikki maydon qo'shilgan va masofa 10 cm

distractors_ru.E: сложены два поля при расстоянии 10 cm

distractors_en.A: the fields were added; they are opposite
distractors_en.C: the field of one charge was taken
distractors_en.D: the distance was taken as 20 cm
distractors_en.E: two fields were added at 10 cm

question_en: Positive charges $q$ and $9q$ are $12\ \mathrm{cm}$ apart. How far from the charge $q$ is the point of zero field ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_uz: $q$ va $9q$ musbat zaryadlar orasidagi masofa $12\ \mathrm{cm}$. Maydon kuchlanganligi nolga teng nuqta $q$ zaryaddan qanday masofada ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_ru: Расстояние между положительными зарядами $q$ и $9q$ равно $12\ \mathrm{cm}$. На каком расстоянии от заряда $q$ находится точка нулевой напряжённости ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. x/(12 − x) = √(1/9) = 1/3, x = 3 cm.
Asos: maydonlar tengligi.

distractors_en.A: this is the distance to the larger charge
distractors_en.B: the square root was not taken: 1/9
distractors_en.D: the midpoint — the charges are not equal

question_en: A ball of mass $1\ \mathrm{g}$ with charge $2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ hangs on a thread in a horizontal uniform field; the thread is deflected $45^\circ$ from the vertical. Find the field strength ($\mathrm{V/m}$). $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_uz: Massasi $1\ \mathrm{g}$, zaryadi $2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ bo'lgan sharcha gorizontal bir jinsli maydonda ipga osilgan, ip vertikaldan $45^\circ$ og'gan. Maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{V/m}$). $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_ru: Шарик массой $1\ \mathrm{g}$ с зарядом $2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ висит на нити в горизонтальном однородном поле, нить отклонена от вертикали на $45^\circ$. Найдите напряжённость поля ($\mathrm{V/m}$). $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. tg 45° = qE/(mg) = 1, E = mg/q = 0.01/(2·10⁻⁶) = 5000 V/m.
Asos: osilgan sharcha muvozanati.

distractors_en.D: the mass was used in grams
distractors_en.E: the charge was taken in mC

question_en: A metal ball of radius $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ is given a charge of $10\ \mathrm{nC}$. Find the field strength $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ from the centre of the ball ($\mathrm{kV/m}$).
question_uz: Radiusi $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan metall sharga $10\ \mathrm{nC}$ zaryad berilgan. Shar markazidan $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ masofadagi maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{kV/m}$).
question_ru: Металлическому шару радиусом $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ сообщили заряд $10\ \mathrm{nC}$. Найдите напряжённость поля на расстоянии $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ от центра шара ($\mathrm{kV/m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Nuqta shar ichida (r < R): o'tkazgich ichida maydon nolga teng.
Asos: o'tkazgich ichida E = 0.

distractors.A: nuqtaviy zaryad formulasi shar ichida qo'llangan

distractors_ru.A: формула точечного заряда применена внутри шара

distractors_en.A: the point-charge formula was used inside the ball
distractors_en.B: this is the field at the surface
distractors_en.C: the distance was taken as 2 cm from the surface
distractors_en.E: the distance was taken as 10 cm

question_en: The surface charge density of an infinite plane is $8.85\ \mathrm{nC/m^2}$. Find its field strength ($\mathrm{V/m}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
question_uz: Cheksiz tekislikning zaryad sirt zichligi $8.85\ \mathrm{nC/m^2}$. Uning maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{V/m}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
question_ru: Поверхностная плотность заряда бесконечной плоскости $8.85\ \mathrm{nC/m^2}$. Найдите напряжённость её поля ($\mathrm{V/m}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. E = σ/(2ε₀) = 8.85·10⁻⁹/(2 · 8.85·10⁻¹²) = 500 V/m.
Asos: tekislik maydoni.

distractors.A: σ/ε₀ — bu ikki tekislik orasidagi maydon

distractors_en.A: σ/ε₀ is the field between two planes
distractors_en.C: there is a field around the plane

question_en: Two parallel planes are charged with densities $+2.655\ \mu\mathrm{C/m^2}$ and $-2.655\ \mu\mathrm{C/m^2}$. Find the field between them ($\mathrm{kV/m}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
question_uz: Ikki parallel tekislik $+2.655\ \mu\mathrm{C/m^2}$ va $-2.655\ \mu\mathrm{C/m^2}$ zichlik bilan zaryadlangan. Ular orasidagi maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{kV/m}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
question_ru: Две параллельные плоскости заряжены с плотностями $+2.655\ \mu\mathrm{C/m^2}$ и $-2.655\ \mu\mathrm{C/m^2}$. Найдите напряжённость поля между ними ($\mathrm{kV/m}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Orasida maydonlar qo'shiladi: E = σ/ε₀ = 2.655·10⁻⁶/8.85·10⁻¹² = 3·10⁵ V/m.
Asos: ikki tekislik maydoni.

distractors_en.A: the field of one plane was taken

question_en: A dielectric plate with $\varepsilon=3$ is placed perpendicular to a uniform field of $900\ \mathrm{V/m}$. Find the field strength inside the plate ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_uz: Kuchlanganligi $900\ \mathrm{V/m}$ bo'lgan bir jinsli maydonga maydonga perpendikulyar qilib $\varepsilon=3$ bo'lgan dielektrik plastina kiritildi. Plastina ichidagi maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
question_ru: В однородное поле напряжённостью $900\ \mathrm{V/m}$ перпендикулярно полю внесли диэлектрическую пластину с $\varepsilon=3$. Найдите напряжённость поля внутри пластины ($\mathrm{V/m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Dielektrik maydonni ε marta susaytiradi: E = 900/3 = 300 V/m.
Asos: E = E₀/ε.

distractors_ru.D: E = 0 — внутри проводника, а не диэлектрика

distractors_en.A: the dielectric does change the field
distractors_en.B: the field was multiplied by ε
distractors_en.D: E = 0 holds inside a conductor, not a dielectric
distractors_en.E: the field was divided by ε²

question_en: What acceleration does an electron get in a uniform field of $910\ \mathrm{V/m}$ ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$)? $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$, $m=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$.
question_uz: Kuchlanganligi $910\ \mathrm{V/m}$ bo'lgan bir jinsli maydonda elektron qanday tezlanish oladi ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$)? $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$, $m=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$.
question_ru: Какое ускорение получает электрон в однородном поле напряжённостью $910\ \mathrm{V/m}$ ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$)? $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$, $m=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. a = eE/m = 1.6·10⁻¹⁹ · 910/(9.1·10⁻³¹) = 1.6·10¹⁴ m/s².
Asos: Nyutonning II qonuni, F = eE.

distractors_ru.B: ошибка в степени: в 1000 раз меньше

distractors_en.D: this is the force (N), not the acceleration
distractors_en.E: the field was taken in kV/m

question_en: The figure shows the field lines of two point charges. Determine the signs of the charges.
question_uz: Rasmda ikki nuqtaviy zaryad maydonining kuch chiziqlari ko'rsatilgan. Zaryadlar ishoralarini aniqlang.
question_ru: На рисунке показаны силовые линии поля двух точечных зарядов. Определите знаки зарядов.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Kuch chiziqlari q₁ dan chiqib q₂ ga kiradi: chiziqlar musbat zaryaddan boshlanib, manfiyda tugaydi.
Asos: kuch chiziqlari xossalari.

uz: Chiziqlar $q_1$ dan chiqadi, $q_2$ ga kiradi: $$q_1>0,\qquad q_2<0$$
ru: Линии выходят из $q_1$ и входят в $q_2$: $$q_1>0,\qquad q_2<0$$
en: The lines leave $q_1$ and enter $q_2$: $$q_1>0,\qquad q_2<0$$

distractors.A: chiziqlar q₂ ga kiradi — u manfiy
distractors.B: chiziqlar q₁ dan chiqadi — u musbat
distractors.E: q₂ zaryadsiz bo'lsa, chiziqlar unda tugamaydi

distractors_ru.A: линии входят в q₂ — он отрицательный
distractors_ru.B: линии выходят из q₁ — он положительный
distractors_ru.E: если q₂ не заряжен, линии на нём не заканчиваются

distractors_en.A: the lines enter q₂, so it is negative
distractors_en.B: the lines leave q₁, so it is positive
distractors_en.C: the arrow directions were read in reverse
distractors_en.E: if q₂ were uncharged, the lines would not end on it

question_en: A dust particle of mass $0.1\ \mathrm{mg}$ with charge $+1\ \mathrm{nC}$ moves in a field of $2\ \mathrm{kV/m}$ directed vertically downwards. Find the acceleration of the particle ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$). $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_uz: Massasi $0.1\ \mathrm{mg}$, zaryadi $+1\ \mathrm{nC}$ bo'lgan chang zarrasi vertikal pastga yo'nalgan $2\ \mathrm{kV/m}$ kuchlanganlikli maydonda harakatlanmoqda. Zarra tezlanishini toping ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$). $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_ru: Пылинка массой $0.1\ \mathrm{mg}$ с зарядом $+1\ \mathrm{nC}$ движется в поле напряжённостью $2\ \mathrm{kV/m}$, направленном вертикально вниз. Найдите ускорение пылинки ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$). $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Ikkala kuch pastga: a = g + qE/m = 10 + 10⁻⁹ · 2000/10⁻⁷ = 30 m/s².
Asos: Nyutonning II qonuni.

distractors.C: elektr kuchi og'irlikni muvozanatlaydi deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: принято, что электрическая сила уравновешивает тяжесть

distractors_en.C: the electric force was assumed to balance gravity
distractors_en.D: the mass was not converted from mg
